CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.OdbudowaStanowKont @OkresID INT = 0, @OdbudujBO INT = 1 AS DECLARE @Poczatek DATETIME DECLARE @Koniec DATETIME DECLARE @PoczatekC int DECLARE @KoniecC int
DECLARE @Miesiac INT DECLARE @RokMiesiac DATETIME declare @PoczatekRokMiesiac int declare @KoniecRokMiesiac int
DECLARE @Poziom INT declare @StrPusty varchar(1) set @StrPusty = '' declare @DziennikBO varchar(4) set @DziennikBO = '*BO*'
create table #BO ( KKSNumer int, ODT DECIMAL(15,2), OCT DECIMAL(15,2) ) create table #Obroty ( KKSNumer int, RokMiesiac int, ODT DECIMAL(15,2), ODTB DECIMAL(15,2), OCT DECIMAL(15,2), OCTB DECIMAL(15,2) )
IF @OkresID = 0 SELECT @OkresID = OKR_ID FROM CDN.Okresy WHERE DATEDIFF( dd, '18001228', GetDate() ) BETWEEN OKR_Poczatek AND OKR_Koniec
SELECT @OkresID = OKR_ID, @Poczatek = DATEADD( dd, OKR_Poczatek, '18001228' ), @Koniec = DATEADD( dd, OKR_Koniec, '18001228' ), @PoczatekC = Okr_Poczatek, @KoniecC = Okr_Koniec FROM CDN.Okresy WHERE OKR_ID = @OkresID
IF @OkresID IS NULL BEGIN RAISERROR( 'Brak okresu obrachunkowego', 16, 1 ) RETURN END SET NOCOUNT ON
set @PoczatekRokMiesiac = year(@Poczatek)*100+month(@Poczatek) set @KoniecRokMiesiac = year(@Koniec)*100+month(@Koniec)
BEGIN TRAN
IF @OdbudujBO = 1 BEGIN update cdn.Konta set KKS_BODebet = 0, KKS_BOCredit = 0 where KKS_OkresID = @OkresID
INSERT INTO #BO( KKSNumer, ODT, OCT ) SELECT KKS_GIDNumer, ISNULL( SUM(CASE WHEN DT_DC=1 THEN DT_Kwota ELSE 0 END), 0 ), ISNULL( SUM(CASE WHEN DT_DC=2 THEN DT_Kwota ELSE 0 END), 0 ) FROM CDN.Konta LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.Dekrety ON KKS_GIDNumer=DT_KKSNumer AND (DT_GIDNumer IS NULL OR (not DT_GIDNumer IS NULL and DT_Dziennik=@DziennikBO AND DT_DataDekr BETWEEN @PoczatekC AND @KoniecC)) WHERE KKS_OkresID= @OkresID GROUP BY KKS_GIDNumer
--na analitykach saldo jednostronne UPDATE CDN.Konta SET KKS_BODebet = CASE when KKS_SaldoWgObr = 1 or 1=1 then ODT else case WHEN ODT-OCT>0 THEN ODT-OCT ELSE 0 END end,
KKS_BOCredit = CASE when KKS_SaldoWgObr = 1 or 1=1 then OCT else CASE WHEN OCT-ODT>0 THEN OCT-ODT ELSE 0 END end
FROM CDN.Konta JOIN #BO ON KKS_GIDNumer = KKSNumer WHERE KKS_OkresID = @OkresID
END
INSERT INTO #Obroty( KKSNumer, RokMiesiac, ODT, ODTB, OCT, OCTB ) SELECT KKS_GIDNumer, DT_Rok*100+DT_Miesiac, ISNULL( SUM(CASE WHEN DT_DC=1 AND DT_Bufor=@StrPusty THEN DT_Kwota ELSE 0 END), 0 ), ISNULL( SUM(CASE WHEN DT_DC=1 THEN DT_Kwota ELSE 0 END), 0 ), ISNULL( SUM(CASE WHEN DT_DC=2 AND DT_Bufor=@StrPusty THEN DT_Kwota ELSE 0 END), 0 ), ISNULL( SUM(CASE WHEN DT_DC=2 THEN DT_Kwota ELSE 0 END), 0 ) FROM CDN.Konta JOIN CDN.Dekrety ON KKS_GIDNumer=DT_KKSNumer AND DT_Dziennik <> @DziennikBO AND DT_DataDekr BETWEEN @PoczatekC AND @KoniecC WHERE KKS_OkresID= @OkresID GROUP BY KKS_GIDNumer, DT_Rok*100+DT_Miesiac
INSERT INTO #Obroty( KKSNumer, RokMiesiac, ODT, ODTB, OCT, OCTB ) SELECT KKS_GIDNumer, OkM_Rok*100+OkM_Miesiac, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM CDN.Konta join cdn.OkresyMiesiace on KKS_OkresID = OkM_OkrID left join #Obroty on KKS_GIDNumer = KKSNumer and OkM_Rok*100+OkM_Miesiac = RokMiesiac WHERE KKS_OkresID = @OkresID and KKS_Analityka = 1 and KKSNumer is null
DELETE FROM CDN.Stany WHERE DTS_RokMiesiac BETWEEN @PoczatekRokMiesiac AND @KoniecRokMiesiac
INSERT INTO CDN.Stany( DTS_KKSNumer, DTS_RokMiesiac, DTS_SPID, DTS_ObrotyDebet, DTS_ObrotyDebetBuf, DTS_ObrotyCredit, DTS_ObrotyCreditBuf ) SELECT KKS_GIDNumer, RokMiesiac, 0, ODT, ODTB, OCT, OCTB FROM CDN.Konta JOIN #Obroty ON KKS_GIDNumer = KKSNumer and KKS_Analityka = 1 WHERE KKS_OkresID = @OkresID ORDER by KKS_GIDNumer, RokMiesiac
SET @Miesiac = 0 SET @RokMiesiac = @Poczatek
WHILE @RokMiesiac < @Koniec BEGIN
IF @Miesiac = 0 begin UPDATE a SET a.DTS_ObrotyNarDebet = isnull(a.DTS_ObrotyNarDebet,0) + a.DTS_ObrotyDebet, a.DTS_ObrotyNarCredit = isnull(a.DTS_ObrotyNarCredit,0) + a.DTS_ObrotyCredit, a.DTS_ObrotyNarDebetBuf = isnull(a.DTS_ObrotyNarDebetBuf,0) + a.DTS_ObrotyDebetBuf, a.DTS_ObrotyNarCreditBuf = isnull(a.DTS_ObrotyNarCreditBuf,0) + a.DTS_ObrotyCreditBuf
FROM CDN.Stany a JOIN CDN.Konta ON a.DTS_KKSNumer = KKS_GIDNumer WHERE KKS_OkresID = @OkresID AND DTS_RokMiesiac = Year( @RokMiesiac )*100+Month( @RokMiesiac )
end else begin UPDATE a SET a.DTS_ObrotyNarDebet = isnull(c.DTS_ObrotyNarDebet,0) + isnull(a.DTS_ObrotyDebet,0), a.DTS_ObrotyNarCredit = isnull(c.DTS_ObrotyNarCredit,0) + isnull(a.DTS_ObrotyCredit,0), a.DTS_ObrotyNarDebetBuf = isnull(c.DTS_ObrotyNarDebetBuf,0) + isnull(a.DTS_ObrotyDebetBuf,0), a.DTS_ObrotyNarCreditBuf = isnull(c.DTS_ObrotyNarCreditBuf,0) + isnull(a.DTS_ObrotyCreditBuf,0)
FROM CDN.Stany a JOIN CDN.Konta ON a.DTS_KKSNumer = KKS_GIDNumer JOIN (SELECT b.DTS_KKSNumer DTS_KKSNumer, b.DTS_ObrotyNarDebet DTS_ObrotyNarDebet, b.DTS_ObrotyNarCredit DTS_ObrotyNarCredit, b.DTS_ObrotyNarDebetBuf DTS_ObrotyNarDebetBuf, b.DTS_ObrotyNarCreditBuf DTS_ObrotyNarCreditBuf
FROM CDN.Stany b WHERE b.DTS_RokMiesiac = Year( DATEADD( mm, -1, @RokMiesiac ) )*100+Month( DATEADD( mm, -1, @RokMiesiac ) ) ) c ON c.DTS_KKSNumer = a.DTS_KKSNumer WHERE KKS_OkresID = @OkresID AND a.DTS_RokMiesiac = Year( @RokMiesiac )*100+Month( @RokMiesiac ) end
SET @Miesiac = @Miesiac + 1 SET @RokMiesiac = DATEADD( mm, @Miesiac, @Poczatek ) END
COMMIT TRAN drop table #BO drop table #Obroty
SET NOCOUNT OFF
